# googleads_ad_group_criterion (Resource)

A keyword targeting (or excluding) criterion attached to an ad group. v1 only covers the keyword criterion type — placements, audiences, etc. are out of scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_ad_group_criterion" "shoes" {
  customer_id  = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id  = googleads_ad_group.main.id
  keyword_text = "running shoes"
  match_type   = "EXACT"
  status       = "ENABLED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ad_group_id` (String) Ad group resource name.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.
- `keyword_text` (String) Keyword text (≤80 characters, ≤10 words). Immutable.
- `match_type` (String) EXACT, PHRASE, or BROAD. Immutable.

### Optional

- `cpc_bid_micros` (Number) Optional max CPC bid in micros. Ignored under non-manual-CPC bidding strategies.
- `negative` (Boolean) If true, the keyword is excluded rather than targeted. Immutable.
- `status` (String) ENABLED (default), PAUSED, or REMOVED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/adGroupCriteria/{ag}~{crit}).
